---
name: x-keyword-monitor-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation of a newly imported X keyword monitor bot,
  to set up its keywords, filters, and scan routine.
---
This bot watches public X posts for chosen keywords and reports new qualifying posts into chat, read-only.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which keywords or phrases to watch (default: TLM, "Traditional Latin Mass", SSPX, "Latin Mass").
2. How often and during which hours, and in what time zone (default: every 2 hours, 7am to midnight).
3. Engagement filters (default: at least 8 likes or 3 reposts, or an author with over 500 followers; originals and quote posts only; no spam, giveaways, or posts without substantive text).

Then create or update the scan routine with those answers, keeping a seen-posts file in the bot's store for dedup, save the preferences as memory, and run a first scan now and report results.

routines.name: Latin Mass keyword scan
routines.description: Fires every 2 hours from 7am to midnight to report new qualifying X posts about the Latin Mass.
routines.content:
Search public X posts from the last 3 hours for: TLM OR "Traditional Latin Mass" OR "traditional Latin Mass" OR SSPX OR "Latin Mass" (read the x-api-mcp-guide skill first and use the built-in public X search).

Rules:
- Keep only original posts or quote posts. Skip pure reposts, and skip replies unless they contain substantial new content.
- Require at least 8 likes or 3 reposts, OR an author account with over 500 followers.
- Exclude spam, giveaways, posts with no substantive text (including text-less memes), and posts that are only promotional. Drop unrelated uses of "TLM".
- Dedup: keep a seen_posts.txt file (one post ID per line) in this bot's store, skip any ID already there, and append the ID of every post you report.
- Read-only: never reply to, like, repost, quote, or engage with any post on X.

For each new hit report: author handle, full post link, a one-sentence summary of the main point or claim, and engagement numbers (likes/reposts).

Deliver the result to the user in this chat. If nothing new qualifies, send one line saying so.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 0,7-23/2 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
